source.author: verg
source.text: Ibant obscuri sola sub nocte per umbram, perque domos Ditis vacuas et inania regna:
source.text_original: Ibant obscuri sola sub nocte per umbram, / perque domos Ditis vacuas et inania regna: /
source.text_english: They went in darkness, alone beneath the night through the shadow, and through the empty halls and void realms of Dis:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: veteris sub nocte cupressi sordidus et multa pallens ferrugine taurus stabat adhuc, cui caeruleae per cornua vittae et taxi frons hirta comis; ipse aeger anhelans impatiensque loci visaque exterritus umbra.
reuse.text_original: veteris sub nocte cupressi / sordidus et multa pallens ferrugine taurus / stabat adhuc, cui caeruleae per cornua vittae / et taxi frons hirta comis; ipse aeger anhelans / impatiensque loci visaque exterritus umbra.
reuse.text_english: Beneath the darkness of an ancient cypress stood a bull, dirty and pale with much rust-colored stain still upon it; blue ribbons ran over its horns, and its brow was bristling with yew-like hairs. He himself was sick, panting, and impatient of the place, terrified by the sight even of a shadow.
